author: Evan Edinger
description:
Evan Edinger, Tom Scott, and Matt Gray race across London. Can an e-bike beat the tube or will the car drive across the finish line first? #RaceAcrossLondon 
Thanks to Patrons and Channel members! http://patreon.com/EvanEdinger

This video took over a full year to make, from scripting and planning, to shooting and editing. This video was shot in bloody May of last year! But at long last, it’s here. I really hope you enjoy it! 

A big thank you is in order for everyone that helped bring this video to life. 
A big thanks to Matt and Tom for joining in and being so funny on camera. 
A big thanks to Cambria for being such a lovely producer and bringing everything together with the planning skills I wish I possessed.
A wholesome thank you to my friend Luke for helping shoot the thing as well as cutting my shoulder when I ran into him x

title: We Raced Across London Three Different Ways
